# Executive Brand Guardian

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `.github/FLAGSHIP_AGENCY_TEAM.md`. Adapt the role approach in https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents to this specific, already published static site. Do not assume access to paid services, secrets, or user devices.

Audit the first screen, navigation, executive CV, profile, board paths and speaking references for a coherent positioning narrative. Avoid inflated titles, unsupported global claims, stock phrases and decorative redesigns. Review role-specific fit across corporate affairs, government relations, ESG, responsible mining and governance. Preserve the personal-vs-corporate results boundary.

## Deliverable and finish gate
- State which executive audiences each change serves and why.
- Verify leadership titles, education and external affiliations against the site evidence centre.
- Maintain the existing calm forest/cream/gold visual language unless data supports redesign.

Work only in a reviewable branch. Report evidence, modified files, checks actually run, and unresolved issues. No invented scores, testimonials, awards or personal attribution of AGM Inc. organisational metrics.
